notes: Research outcome is weak. Only 4 chart candidates found, none independently verified. astro.com Astro-Databank blocked WebFetch (bot check), so no Rodden rating was confirmed at source. Every chart came from one AI aggregator (jyothishai.com) that computes its own sidereal values, so it is NOT an independent reference; three of four have exactly 12:00 birth times, which usually signals a default time rather than a real AA record. No latitude/longitude/tz offsets published. Only 1 usable Guna Milan example (auto-generated, arithmetic inconsistency); gunmilan.in and vedicmarga.com returned 522/429 errors. The 15-chart target was NOT met. Recommend obtaining charts by manually downloading Astro-Databank pages (AA) and cross-checking with a second independent Vedic source, or a textbook (e.g. B.V. Raman) for Guna Milan examples.
